title: How Meals Reach a Cell in America's Only Federal Supermax
asof: Figures from the 2018 DC CIC inspection · full video on the channel

shots.s: At this prison, dinner comes through a slot in the door.
ADX Florence, Colorado. America's only federal supermax.
Meals are carried from the kitchen to each cell door.
The tray slides in through the slot.
You eat alone, at a concrete desk.
The food budget was about three dollars fifty a day per man.
The cooks are prisoners from the camp next door.
About a third of men surveyed complained about the food.
One said, we only see staff when they feed us,
pick up the trays, and at recreation.
Could you eat every meal alone for years?
